workflow: Always read all pending todos before forming clusters or plans — pre-clustering before reading produced incorrect groupings that had to be thrown away.
Run parallel subagent verification against live code before planning phases when todos reference specific file paths/LoC — anchors go stale across refactor PRs.
Completed phases frequently leave their todos unfiled in completed/ — treat a 'this looks done' intuition as a bookkeeping verification step, not a skip.
PRs can ship scope from todos without any explicit todo lifecycle update; checking git log for todo anchor files is a reliable signal.
When a large refactor todo has tiered scope, always re-capture the unfinished tier as a new pending todo rather than just moving the original to completed/ to preserve the remaining work record.
